contract_answer.question: Does removing the explicit r_d, r_c capacity-ratio fade inputs worsen the GateRepair parent enough across the three paper splits to credit the fade component?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from the 600 selected-checkpoint predictions (epoch 27) gives split-2024 MAPE 0.115601, Acc@15 0.7367, RMSE 24.393 cycles, bias +2.156, prediction/target std 44.95/40.39, versus NA-E011 MAPE 0.109135, Acc@15 0.7433, RMSE 24.310, bias +0.514, std 44.88/40.39 (delta MAPE +0.006466). Prefix bands (ablation vs parent): 01-10 0.1840 vs 0.1539; 11-25 0.1384 vs 0.1337; 26-50 0.1288 vs 0.1370; 51-75 0.0899 vs 0.0884; 76-100 0.0870 vs 0.0693. Per-cell MAPE: 3-1-56 0.0776 vs 0.0596; 3-2-55 0.1181 vs 0.1009; 4-1-48 0.0628 vs 0.0416; 5-2-38 0.0847 vs 0.0714; 6-2-30 0.1582 vs 0.1832; 7-1-23 0.1921 vs 0.1982. Family 3-split MAPE 0.129589 +/- 0.054465 (sample std) versus parent 0.108654 +/- 0.008549; mean delta +0.020936, meeting the +0.008 credit threshold, so the component is credited.

main_symptom: Split 2024: ablation MAPE 0.1156 vs parent 0.1091 (+0.0065); family mean +0.0209 worse than parent with sample std 0.0545. Diagnostics are finite, padding-invariant, with overall_gradient_health=WARNING from branch imbalance (ext_da/tcn_norm ratio 1.82e+05).

causes.interpretation: The capacity-ratio fade state carries degradation-level information the curve encoder and TCN do not recover reliably; without it the network underestimates spread (prediction std shrinks) on the hardest split. On this split removal worsens MAPE by +0.0065.
missing_evidence: Repeated-seed variance within each locked split

causes.interpretation: With six validation cells per split and one seed, the family mean is dominated by split 42 (+0.0727); split 2021 improves and split 2024 worsens only slightly, so the credit rests largely on one split.
missing_evidence: Matched reruns with different initialization seeds on the same locked splits
